notes.title: Halver 0.9.1 update
notes.content:
After nearly two months of productive work, we are introducing Steam Achievements for the Halver!

They are categorized into four difficulty levels:
[list]
[*] EASY ― In green color
[*] MEDIUM ― In yellow color
[*] HARD ― In red color
[*] INSANE ― Tough, in purple
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40818503/92913887e3057585be80a5796987465dcb706e28.png[/img]

More detailed description of achievements:
https://steamcommunity.com/stats/1358440/achievements


If you unlock all the achievements, you will be able to set new skin for the main hero:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40818503/2c6a933b6d8353b2d88cbc313970f6bafc75a8e3.gif[/img]

We have tried to make achievements as interesting as possible to highlight hidden aspects of the game. You can think of them as a new game mode

Update Notes 0.9.1:
• Introduced Steam Achievements
• Added hints to all the levels
• Enhanced aiming algorithm
• Hints kept until level passed
• Fixed issue with changing resolution on some devices
• Resolved disappearing music on level 48

Minor changes:
• Added various fairy messages
• Started work on Speedrun game mode
• Fixed several issues with levels game objects
• Updated Unity version up to 2022.3.30f1
• Updated Steamworks SDK to 1.57

P.S. We are working on the Level Editor, but decided to provide achievements for you earlier : )

notes.title: Christmas greetings!
notes.content:

🎄 Friends, we congratulate you on the upcoming New Year and Christmas on behalf of the indie game teams behind Zero Orders Tactics, Broken Soul, Being The Game, Folk Hero, Halver, and our entire indie community!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2390420/Being_The_Game/

🎉 We wish you in the new year to quickly solve any puzzles, always choose the right tactics, actively explore the world, never stop believing in fairy tales, and make friends with your inner demons. May the upcoming year bring you exciting adventures and numerous victories not only in games but also in real life!

We hope that the unique worlds we've created will bring you many joyful moments during the New Year holidays 🎮
